Combat Writing 0.3.1. The crew is one fresh reader plus whatever outside seats the add-on registers, never padded: `new-run.js` seats exactly one and refuses `--seats`, and `packet.js` refuses a second fresh reader left in an older run's `seats.json`, so it gets no packet and no agent. The credit line is removed from every run output: it no longer appears in packets, `seats.json`, the log, `record.md`, the short form or `board.html`, and stands once, at the foot of `/combat-writing:help`. CI runs every check in `tests/` and `claude plugin validate --strict` on each pull request to main and on main, and gates a pull request that changes a plugin folder on a version bump, naming the plugin that forgot.
